display_long_description:
# A.I. + MIXED REALITY, AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

MRx is the easy no-code solution for A.I. enhanced Mixed Reality experiences. With MRx, you can create your own A.I.-infused interactive and immersive content, then deploy it at-scale to collaborative team-based sessions. 

Simple, versatile and powerful, MRx lets you harness the combined affordances of these technologies where you need it, from improving learning and training outcomes to elevating visualization or other engagements.

**How it works:**
1. Add your own assets (3D models, images or videos) and create A.I. bots for your Mixed Reality content via the MRx Console PC app.

2. In Mixed Reality, select the assets and A.I. bots to place into content scenes and apply various interaction behaviors.

3. Playback your content automatically in collaborative participant sessions and facilitate with the desktop Session Manager.

Refer to the user guide at http://serl.io/mrx
